title: skills(pm-dispatch): optimization flight — monorepo-only lore cut, the report JSON printed once, upstream reporting pointed at objectstack-platform, five drifts synced to the dev contract (net −2,982 tokens)
body:
Part of #14300

Member card of the skills catalog optimization program #14292 (maintainer mandate 2026-09-02, verbatim: 「审核所有的 skills，进行全面的优化。」). The audit record (`audit/objectstack-pm-dispatch/findings.md`) is the second comment on #14300 and is the finding-by-finding spec for this PR. PMD-B-01 (split the template into `rules/`) and PMD-H-01 (evals) are deferred to #14296 items 1 + 4 and 2, so this PR is `Part of` and #14300 remains open. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01LraLgQVGq8egUwfYZpbYt1 — branch `claude/issue-14300-skills-pm-dispatch-optimization`, base `96b627d1`, head `ea50dfb5`.

Files: `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (hand-edited, shrink-only), plus `skills/README.md` and `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx` as generator output only (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:skill-docs`, forced by the PMD-A-01 description edit). `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` were read as the comparison oracle and are not touched. No other package. `Clause-②: no` — no contract surface (0 TypeScript fences, no accept/reject semantics).

### Gap vs the card's target (≈ −3,600 after exclusions) — itemised, not smoothed

Delivered −2,982; the card's post-exclusion estimate was ≈ −3,600 (its −4,255 minus deferred PMD-B-01's share, minus PMD-D-04, minus the drift-sync additions). The ≈ 620-token gap, by source:

`excluded_by_gate: PMD-D-04 — check:skill-frame-sync pins both copies` — the gate anchors the PM copy at "every option on the four fixed axes below." (`:643` → `:540`) and the template copy at "Analyze every option on four fixed axes:" (`:832` → `:729`), 4 copies / 3 files / 4 axes; D-04's only remedy removes a copy the gate requires. Neither axis block is edited.

`premise_false:` none — every audited span was found at its stated lines (the file is byte-identical between `a59f78d` and `96b627d1`).

Not in this flight (listed, not smoothed): PMD-A-02 (README routing bullet, +25 unpaid, needs a ruling), PMD-E-06 (LOW-confidence reorder, not in the card's table), PMD-B-01 / PMD-H-01 (deferred to #14296).

### Deviations disclosed

- Marker spelling: the published skill keeps its own `dev-report` marker (made a fixed literal rather than "such as"); the internal `os-dev-report` is this repo's instance of it, not a published name.
- Commit order: cluster 2 (D-01/D-02/D-03/E-04) landed after clusters 3 and 4 because its first run stopped on its own residue-size assertion (261 > 250) before writing anything; no partial write reached the tree (ratchet re-read 12,385 both before and after the aborted run).

### Follow-up sync once #14229 merges (⛔ not pre-synced — unmerged text)

1. the verify-lock non-guarantee clause;
2. the ratchet funding discipline.

Re-derived union — `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` from the tree at `ea50dfb5` ("gate list derived from the tree of 'objectstack-ai/objectstack' at commit ea50dfb5"), 36 commands, each exit code captured by redirect before any pipe: 33 green on the first pass; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` and `… check:doc-security-posture` green after building `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/lint` (first pass exit 3 = PREREQUISITE NOT MET, not a red); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` — green after building `types` / `client` / `client-react` ("✅ 259 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s) — every marked block parsed, so tsc ran the SEMANTIC pass on all of them"; the first-pass exit 1 was the gate's own prerequisite refusal, `packages/client-react/dist` unbuilt); `node scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs` — NOT MEASURED locally by the gate's own design (exit 3: "grades a saved `turbo run test` log, and no log was named"; CI tees the log). `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` — "✓ No empty-frontmatter changeset introduced by this diff".
